messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm putting together a small mapping doc for voice->intent for SDK examples. Need thumbs on naming conventions for 'route' vs 'endpoint' in docs. PR coming in a minute: #7123. Customers say 'endpoint' sounds infra-y, want clearer UX term.

alex: We used 'route' in earlier API guides to mean high-level routes. I prefer 'route' for user-facing docs and 'endpoint' in low-level API ref. +1 for a mapping table.

samir: Agree. Also flag: inconsistent capitalization of model names (e.g., 'Redwood-2' vs 'redwood 2'). Should glossary enforce Title Case? cc @jordan

jordan: Glossary should be 'Redwood 2' (product names Title Case). Model family names can be lowercase when referenced generically. Quick rule proposal: product names Title Case, API fields lower_snake_case, SDK classes UpperCamelCase.

docs-bot: PR #7123 opened by maria: docs/voice-intent-mapping.md — reviewers requested: alex, jordan

alex: Reviewing now. Quick note on code snippets: prefer explicit `client.chat.generate()` in examples rather than generic `client.generate()` so it's clear which surface is used. I'll leave inline comments.

maria: Thanks — I'll swap snippets. Also found three broken links to internal eval dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals -> needs redirect to /console/evals. I will include link fixes in the same PR.

samir: Can we add a tiny section in the mapping doc that lists canonical prompt triggers for QA? e.g., 'summarize:' vs 'tl;dr' — helps evals. Example I sketched: 
```
Prompt intent: summarize
Canonical trigger: 'Summarize the following:'
Avoid: 'tl;dr'
```

jordan: :thumbsup: Love the prompt canon idea. Once PR merges I'll run the docs linter across the repo to catch casing issues. Also suggest adding an automated check to catch mixed 'endpoint' vs 'route' usage.

maria: Added a linter rule draft and tiny test to the repo at `tools/docs-lint/rules/terminology.js` and pushed a commit. PTAL. If no blockers I'll merge by EOD. Thanks all!
